profile.title: Profile
profile.nicknameHint: Your specialist sees this instead of your real name.

security.title: Security
security.passwordTooShort: Your new password must be at least 12 characters.
security.setupIntro: Add your account to your authenticator app by opening the link on this phone, or by typing the key in by hand.
security.disableIntro: To turn off the authenticator app, enter your password and a current code from it.
security.generateBody: Your current codes stop working at once, and you get 10 new codes that are shown only once.
security.codesNote: Shown only once. Keep them somewhere safe; your old codes no longer work.
security.sessionEnded: That device has been signed out.
security.reauthIntro: To make sure it’s you, enter your password.
security.reauthIntroTotp: To make sure it’s you, enter your password and a current code from your authenticator app.
security.endBody: That device will need to sign in again.
security.signOutAllBody: We’ll end every session, including this one, and you’ll need to sign in again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.neutralHint: Shows “You have a reminder” instead of the message
notifications.quickExitHint: Takes you straight to an ordinary page
notifications.emergencyNote: Calls from the emergency team always reach you, even during quiet hours.

safety.title: Emergency contact and location
safety.intro: Used only if you are in danger and we can't reach you. Every access appears in the access log.
safety.shareLocation: Share my location in an emergency
safety.deleteBody: We won't be able to reach the person you trust if you are in danger and we can't reach you. You can add them again at any time.

quickExit.label: Quick exit
quickExit.aria: Quick exit: go straight to an ordinary page
